answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 29549 Country: OM Title: I am from India Hyderabad. but i am working in Oman , Muscat here the Omani follow some other Maslak it is called as Ibadi Maslak some thing like that. my question is that in Zohar and Asar Prayers with Jamat for Farz Namaz they only read Sure Fatiha in all fore Rakats . unlike us we read Sure Fatiha and then Qirat in first two Rakat of Farz Namaz in Zohar and Asar. so if we pray behind them will our Namaz will be done or i should pray saprately. please let me know i am in grate confusion. Question: Asslam U alikum Mufti sahab i am from India Hyderabad. but i am working in Oman , Muscat here the Omani follow some other Maslak it is called as Ibadi Maslak some thing like that. my question is that in Zohar and Asar Prayers with Jamat for Farz Namaz they only read Sure Fatiha in all fore Rakats . unlike us we read Sure Fatiha and then Qirat in first two Rakat of Farz Namaz in Zohar and Asar. so if we pray behind them will our Namaz will be done or i should pray saprately. please let me know i am in grate confusion. Allahafiz. Answer ID: 29549 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 350/350/M=1432) The Ibadi sect (اباضی) exists in Muscat and ‘Ibadi (عبادی) might be its misspelt name. We do not have complete knowledge about the beliefs of Ibadi sect. However, this sect is attributed to Abdullah ibn Ibadh and it is a branch of Khawarij sect. Their beliefs are found in the books. If this sect (Ibadiah) is the same and it holds the same beliefs, then salah should not be offered behind them, it will not be valid. (Ahsan al-Fatawa 1/198) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
